title: Hold a traders licence (motor vehicle dealer)
what: Hold a traders licence for the motor vehicle dealer category before dealing in motor vehicles.

sources.title: Traders (Licensing) Act 2016 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 45(1) (current republication (R4, from 5 January 2026; Traders (Licensing) Act 2016 | Acts))
sources.quote: A person commits an offence if the person— (a) carries out a licensed activity; and (b) is not licensed to carry out the licensed activity.

sources.title: Traders (Licensing) Act 2016 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 8 (current republication (R4, from 5 January 2026; Traders (Licensing) Act 2016 | Acts))
sources.quote: Each of the following (a trader category) is a trader: (a) motor vehicle dealer; (b) motor vehicle repairer;
